beats.narration_en: Same car, same speed. Watch closely what these two different bumps do to it.
The short bump jolts the wheels in a flash, while the long one lifts the whole car slowly.
At thirty kilometers per hour, the short bump still hits about twice as hard as the long one.
At ten, the long hump turns gentle, but the short bump still jolts the car.
In this simulation the short bump is about two to six times harsher at every speed.
So it is not just the height. It is how quickly the road lifts your car.
